text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly implements national-scale spatial LULC prediction for Romania using the CLUE-S model. It focuses centrally on simulating future agricultural land use changes from 2007–2050 under two distinct quantitative scenarios (S1 based on 1990–2000 trends, S2 based on 2000–2006 trends). The modeling uses CORINE Land Cover data, 18 biophysical and socio-economic explanatory variables, and produces mapped projections of agricultural land classes. Quantitative accuracy metrics are reported, including Overall Accuracy (85.7–86.1%), Kappa (0.8–0.82), and ROC/AUC values. The study covers the entire territory of Romania at 500m resolution, satisfying explicit national-scale implementation. All core inclusion criteria are met, and none of the exclusion criteria apply.)
